观察心房与心室的先后变化。: Observe the sequence of changes in the atria and ventricles.
心房と心室の変化の順序を観察します。
心室充盈时，房室瓣开放。: The atrioventricular valves open during ventricular filling.
心室が充満するとき、房室弁が開きます。

心室から血液が駆出されるとき、半月弁が開きます。
瓣膜随心动周期开放与关闭，两侧压力差推动血液单向流动。: Valves open and close with the cardiac cycle. Pressure differences across them drive blood in one direction.

静脉血汇入腔静脉，回到右心房。: Venous blood enters the venae cavae and returns to the right atrium.
静脈血は大静脈に集まり、右心房へ戻ります。
从左心室射出的血液经主动脉进入体循环，回流最终汇入腔静脉和右心房。展示主要通路的: Blood ejected from the left ventricle enters the systemic circulation through the aorta, ultimately returning through the venae cavae to the right atrium. The demonstration shows the sequence of the main pathways.
